completion_data.completion_summary: Phase 5 of 7 complete. Landed three new declarations in FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/RaySummary/LadderWindow.lean: CellSubsetOfKappaEqWindowRaise (the window regime's depth-0 cell obligation as a schema, with direction-indexed cell inclusion as the conclusion), cellSubset_of_kappa_eq_window_raise (its theorem, proved from kappa_collision_window_room plus the single landed cellAt_subset_of_window_raise), and kappa_collision_window_or_pendPast_exhaustive (the regimes' exhaustiveness at a fixed register, derived from clipIdx_regime_of_eq and pend_past_of_nxtAt_lt). memory_candidates: A one-directional cell-inclusion result stated symmetrically as two direction-indexed implications, with the reverse half discharged as vacuous, makes which side of a collision the arithmetic pays for explicit in the statement -- strictly more informative than stating the single inclusion the quantifier order happens to admit.

When a plan specifies Set.Subset.antisymm over a matched pair of inclusions and only one inclusion is landed, renaming the schema to say Subset rather than keeping the equality-suggesting name is what keeps the weaker conclusion visible to a reader comparing it against sibling schemas.
